description:
HORZONYX is a team of four passionate young innovators participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Driven by creativity, technology, and curiosity, we aim to build an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer that inspires young minds to explore space, experience astronaut training, and understand the wonders of space missions. We believe innovation has no boundaries and the future belongs to curious explorers.

HORZONYX – Beyond Imagination. Towards Infinity.
summary:
We are Team Horzonyx. Our project is called Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.

It is an educational game about astronaut survival in space.

In this game, players must protect astronauts for eight days.

We have four main systems: Air, Power, Shield and Food.

Every day, players receive three working hours. They must distribute these hours carefully to maintain all four systems.

Our game includes different space environments such as the Venus ,Mars, Europa, Titan , Ceres , Asteroid , Space Station , Moon

Through this project, students can learn space science, resource management, teamwork and decision-making.
